title: Senior Multi Media Producer
description:

Sigma Inc. is seeking an experienced Senior Multimedia Producer to support a fast-paced Strategic Communications & Marketing team in East Boston, MA.

You'll lead creative projects from concept to completion, manage internal and external creative teams, direct on-site productions, and ensure high-quality multimedia content is delivered across social media, digital platforms, broadcast, and live events.

  • Collaborate with marketing, branding, social media, strategy, and executive stakeholders to define project requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience
  • 5–10 years of experience in video production, photography, and event production
  • Experience producing content for social media, digital platforms, broadcast, and live events
  • Strong portfolio or demo reel showcasing multimedia production work
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Lightroom, After Effects) and/or Final Cut Pro
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Mac platforms, Google Drive, and production collaboration tools
  • Strong understanding of professional video, photography, lighting, and audio production equipment
  • Excellent project management, scheduling, budgeting, and organizational skills
  • Strong communication, creative storytelling, and stakeholder management abilities
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality across all assignments

⭐ Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in agency, studio, or in-house creative production environments
  • Familiarity with Asana, Frame.io, or similar project management and review platforms
  • Experience managing external creative agencies and freelance production teams
  • Background in large-scale corporate event production and multimedia campaigns

📌 Work Environment & Additional Requirements

  • Hybrid work schedule (3 days onsite, up to 2 days remote)
  • Standard 37.5-hour workweek with flexibility for evenings and weekends as production schedules require
  • Willingness to travel to all Massport properties for productions and events
  • Collaborative team player willing to support additional business needs

title: Animal Care Technician
description:
37245353 Animal Care Technician

📍 Fulton, MO
📅 9-Month Contract
🕒 Full-Time | 40 Hours/Week
🏢 Sigma Inc.

Job Summary

Sigma Inc. is seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Animal Care Technician to support operations in a regulated animal research laboratory environment in Fulton, Missouri.

This is a 9-month full-time contract position requiring hands-on experience in animal husbandry, livestock handling, veterinary support, or scientific animal research. The role operates under strict compliance with Animal Welfare Act Regulations, NIH Guidelines, USDA standards, and AAALAC accreditation requirements.

If you have experience in animal care, veterinary clinical assistance, livestock handling, or research laboratory environments, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform animal husbandry and health care in accordance with experimental protocols and federal regulations

  • Provide daily animal care including feed, water, and enrichment materials

  • Conduct daily health and welfare assessments

  • Recognize signs of illness or distress and report findings to Site Veterinarian or Team Leader

  • Assist with scientific procedures and clinical R&D sample collection per study protocols

  • Maintain and document:

    • Animal care records

    • Preventive medicine logs

    • USDA-required documentation

    • Study protocol documentation

  • Clean and sanitize animal rooms and equipment

  • Maintain, adjust, and repair:

    • Animal pens

    • Feeding systems

    • Drinking systems

    • Livestock handling equipment

  • Support biosecurity procedures including water sanitation, feed decontamination, and environmental sample collection

  • Assist in ante-mortem and post-mortem procedures

  • Ensure compliance with USDA, EPA, NIH Guide, AAALAC standards, and company policies

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED

  • Minimum 2 years of related experience, such as:

    • Livestock handling

    • Animal husbandry

    • Veterinary clinical assistance

    • Scientific animal research

  • Willingness to obtain Assistant Laboratory Animal Technician (ALAT) certification within 12 months (if not already certified)

  • Must be 18 years of age or older

  • Legally authorized to work in the U.S.

  • Willing to complete drug screening and post-offer physical (if required)

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Ability to lift:

    • Up to 70 lbs occasionally

    • Up to 50 lbs frequently

  • Must work in environments that may be:

    • Hot or cold

    • Humid

    • Noisy

  • Must not have allergies to animals or livestock/feed dust

  • Ability to work under biosafety laboratory conditions

  • Willingness to work weekends (every 5th weekend rotation)

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented research environment

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills

  • Basic computer proficiency (email, word processing)

  • Ability to manage processes and work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment

  • Sound judgment and analytical thinking skills

title: Community Housing Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Community Housing Coordinator
Job ID: 16261-1 A
Location: Pittsburgh, PA (Remote with Local Travel)
Duration: 8+ Months
Shift Schedule: Monday to Friday (Business Hours; occasional evenings/weekends for community events)
Job Type: Contract (USC Only)

About Sigma Systems Inc. (Staffing Agency)
Sigma Systems Inc. is seeking a Community Housing Coordinator on behalf of our client based in Pittsburgh, PA. We specialize in connecting skilled professionals with impactful opportunities across healthcare and community services. This position offers the flexibility of remote work combined with meaningful field engagement supporting at-risk populations.

Due to the governmental nature of this role, only US Citizens are eligible to apply.

Position Overview: Community Housing Coordinator
Sigma Systems Inc. is hiring a Community Housing Coordinator to support members in identifying and securing affordable, accessible, and sustainable housing options. This role requires a balance of remote work and local travel, engaging directly with members and community partners to remove barriers and improve housing stability.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Housing Coordination and Member Support:
    o Research, evaluate, and analyze demographic data to identify viable housing and utility support options
    o Identify member barriers and develop action plans to guide members toward sustainable housing solutions
    o Engage in empowering interactions to support member independence and stability
  2. Community Engagement and Outreach:
    o Meet with health plan members face-to-face to support their housing needs
    o Represent the organization at community events and partner-sponsored initiatives
    o Build and maintain strong relationships with local housing agencies and organizations
  3. Collaboration and Liaison Activities:
    o Act as a liaison between members, Case Managers, and housing agencies
    o Collaborate with federal, state, and local agencies (including HUD and housing authorities)
    o Support coordinated efforts to connect members with appropriate resources
  4. Documentation and Compliance:
    o Utilize the health plan’s system of record to document all member interactions
    o Maintain accurate and timely documentation in compliance with organizational standards
  5. Program Development and Continuous Improvement:
    o Participate in developing innovative and measurable programs focused on at-risk populations
    o Serve as a subject matter expert in affordable housing options
    o Identify opportunities to improve housing support services and member outcomes

Qualifications:

• Education:
o High School Diploma or GED required

• Experience:
o 1 year of experience in community outreach or customer service
o 1 year working with at-risk populations (preferred)
o Experience with Medicaid regulations
o Experience in healthcare customer/member services
o Experience working with unhoused populations

Skills:
o Strong knowledge of customer service principles, including needs assessment and quality standards
o Ability to work collaboratively with peers, supervisors, and customers
o Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and self-directed approach
o Ability to multitask and respond promptly to member needs
o Excellent written and verbal communication skills
o Cultural competency and sensitivity toward Medicaid populations, including those with limited English proficiency
o Understanding of barriers such as transportation, childcare, and healthcare access
o Demonstrated patience and empathy in all interactions
o Ability to establish relationships with housing authorities and agencies
o Knowledge of federal and state housing laws, Medicaid programs, and benefit packages

Work Schedule & Conditions:
• Remote position with local travel required up to 75% (travel is reimbursable)
• Must reside within one of the following Southwest PA counties:
Allegheny, Armstrong, Beaver, Bedford, Blair, Butler, Cambria, Fayette, Greene, Indiana, Lawrence, Somerset, Washington, Westmoreland
• Schedule includes regular business hours Monday – Friday with occasional evening or weekend availability for community events

Why Work with Sigma Systems Inc.?
• Opportunity to make a direct impact in community health and housing stability
• Flexible remote work environment with community engagement
• Competitive compensation and reimbursable travel
• Work with a dedicated team supporting vulnerable populations

How to Apply
If you are passionate about community outreach and helping individuals secure stable housing, apply now with your resume.

Program Manager – Capital Projects Overview

Sigma Inc. is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead the design, construction, and commissioning of a large-scale animal vaccine manufacturing facility in St. Joseph, Missouri.

This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned capital projects professional with expertise in pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology, life sciences, industrial construction, or large-scale facility expansions. The selected candidate will oversee all phases of project execution, from planning and design through construction, validation, commissioning, and operational readiness.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong background managing capital projects exceeding $100 million, working with cross-functional stakeholders, engineering teams, EPC firms, contractors, and executive leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Capital Project Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end project delivery for the design, construction, commissioning, and startup of a large-scale vaccine manufacturing facility.

  • Oversee project planning activities, governance processes, risk management strategies, and performance reporting.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Provide leadership across multiple departments and functional teams, both directly and indirectly.

Governance & Risk Management

  • Establish project governance structures and reporting mechanisms.
  • Maintain risk registers, mitigation plans, issue logs, and executive reporting dashboards.
  • Ensure adherence to project controls, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related technical discipline.
  • Extensive experience managing large-scale capital projects, facility expansions, or new construction projects.
  • Proven experience delivering projects exceeding $100 million in capital investment.
  • Strong understanding of Front-End Loading (FEL) processes and capital project lifecycles.
  • Experience managing engineering, construction, commissioning, and startup activities.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional project teams.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with EPC firms, contractors, and equipment suppliers.

title: Dental Assistant
description:
Job Title: Dental Assistant – Contract 

Job ID: 3687
Location: Boston, MA
Schedule: Monday – Thursday: 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM | Friday: 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM
Job Type: Contract | 3 Months

About Sigma Systems

Sigma Systems is a trusted staffing partner connecting skilled healthcare professionals with leading medical, academic, and government organizations across the United States. We are committed to placing exceptional talent in rewarding contract opportunities while delivering outstanding service to our clients.

Position Overview

Sigma Systems is seeking a Dental Assistant for a full-time 3-month onsite contract opportunity in Boston, MA. This position supports a Pre-Doctoral Group Practice, working alongside dental students, faculty, and patients in a fast-paced academic clinical environment.

The ideal candidate is a licensed and certified Dental Assistant with strong clinical experience, excellent communication skills, and a passion for delivering compassionate patient care. This role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to an academic dental setting while supporting the education of future dental professionals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide chairside assistance to dental students using four-handed dentistry techniques.
  • Prepare operatories before procedures and disinfect treatment rooms between patients.
  • Prepare instrument cassettes for sterilization following established infection control protocols.
  • Organize, monitor, and replenish dental supplies to ensure uninterrupted clinic operations.
  • Provide coverage during evening and Saturday clinics as needed.
  • Review treatment plans with patients and explain dental procedures clearly.
  • Model effective patient communication and management techniques for dental students.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, compassion, and empathy while delivering patient care.
  • Collaborate with faculty and clinical staff to ensure efficient clinic operations.
  • Support multiple students and manage up to eight operatories in a busy clinical environment.
  • Utilize Microsoft Office applications for communication and administrative tasks.

Qualifications

  • Current Massachusetts Dental Assistant License (Required)
  • Certified Dental Assistant (CDA), Expanded Functions Dental Assistant (EFDA), or Formally Trained Dental Assistant (FTDA) (Required)
  • Current CPR Certification (Required)
  • Current Dental Radiology Certification (Required)
  • Previous experience as a Dental Assistant in a dental practice or clinical dental care environment
  • Strong knowledge of dental terminology, procedures, and treatment planning
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to multitask
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced academic clinic environment
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Bilingual candidates are highly preferred but not required

Additional Requirements

  • Maintain Dental Assistant certification through continuing education (CE) courses.
  • Provide proof of required immunizations and health clearances, including:
    • Measles, Mumps & Rubella (MMR)
    • Hepatitis B
    • Varicella (Chickenpox)
    • Tdap (Tetanus, Diphtheria, Pertussis)
    • Annual Tuberculosis (TB) testing
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team while maintaining high standards of patient care.

Why Work with Sigma Systems?

  • Opportunity to work with one of Boston's premier academic dental institutions.
  • Gain valuable experience in a collaborative educational healthcare environment.
  • Competitive compensation for contract professionals.
  • Ongoing support from Sigma Systems' experienced recruiting and staffing team.
  • Make a meaningful impact by supporting quality patient care and the education of future dental professionals.

How to Apply

If you're a licensed and certified Dental Assistant looking for an exciting contract opportunity in an academic clinical setting, we'd love to hear from you. Submit your updated resume today for immediate consideration.

For questions about this opportunity, please contact Sigma Systems.
